headline: Fino Payments Bank crosses ₹3,000 crore in deposits with a 316% jump in loan disbursals for October
hook: Record deposits and soaring loan disbursals
summary: Fino Payments Bank reported that average deposits rose 9% year-on-year to ₹2,886 crore in October, with total deposits crossing ₹3,000 crore for the first time. Loan referral disbursals surged 316% to ₹301 crore during the same period. However, transaction business throughput declined by 18% month-on-month. Retail investors holding the stock should note the divergence between strong deposit and loan growth and falling transaction volumes.
why_it_matters: Strong deposit and loan growth boosts core banking income.
winners_losers: Fino Payments Bank gains / Transaction business hurt

headline: RBI set to approve Fino Payments Bank's transition to small finance bank
hook: Final approval on the cards for Fino
summary: Fino Payments Bank is reportedly close to receiving final approval from the Reserve Bank of India to transition into a small finance bank, though conditions and riders are expected. This shift will allow the institution to expand its product suite, including offering full-scale credit and loans. For retail investors and customers, the conversion marks a structural evolution in the bank's operational model. The development carries regulatory significance for fintech-backed banking entities seeking full banking licenses.
whats_next: Official RBI notification on SFB transition
why_it_matters: Fino can soon offer full lending and credit products.
winners_losers: Fino gains / traditional peers face new competition

headline: Fino Payments Bank receives an ESG rating upgrade to Crisil ESG 59-Adequate
summary: Fino Payments Bank has received an ESG rating upgrade to 'Crisil ESG 59-Adequate' from Crisil. This rating reflects the bank's adequacy in environmental, social, and governance practices.
